commits.subject: components (SMB-FIG-SMART-ANIMATE-2 slice 1): spring easing, directional placement, gradient tween, text-by-content matching
interop-fig + harness (SMB-FIG-SMART-ANIMATE-2 slice 2): directional and spring transitions from .fig, played
harness tests (SMB-FIG-SMART-ANIMATE-2 slice 2 pins): gradient orb centre colour, clippy

capabilities_done: (1) directional transitions: interop-fig maps the file schema's TransitionType tokens MOVE_FROM_*, PUSH_FROM_*, SLIDE_FROM_*, MOVE_OUT_TO_*, SLIDE_OUT_TO_* (x LEFT/RIGHT/TOP/BOTTOM, all 20 asserted present in the fixture's Kiwi enum) to STU-PRO-118 MOVE_IN/PUSH/SLIDE_IN/MOVE_OUT/SLIDE_OUT + direction, transitionShouldSmartAnimate -> match_layers, FADE -> DISSOLVE (typed note); unknown tokens stay transition_not_mapped. components::directional_frame places both screens (direction = edge entered from / left toward; slide parallax 0.3, Studio-declared); ActiveTransition carries transition_type/direction/spring. Harness play mode draws directional transitions by shifting the two screen rasters (pixel-exact test of a PUSH_FROM_RIGHT); with match_layers the matched layers smart-animate and unmatched top-level layers move with the screens instead of dissolving

(2) spring easing: components::spring_progress / spring_displacement / spring_settle_ms solve m x'' + c x' + k x = 0 analytically (under, critical, over-damped; initial velocity); the player's eased progress follows the spring in elapsed seconds and is 1 at the stored duration (spring_easing_played_linear diagnostic removed). interop-fig maps CUSTOM_SPRING easingFunction in the plugin-API order {mass, stiffness, damping, initialVelocity} (3 values = zero velocity) with typed note spring_parameter_order_unverified; out-of-range sets and the named spring presets (no published numbers) stay easing_without_studio_tuple_linear_used

(3) gradient fill tweening: SmartProps.gradient (kind, stops, handle transform); same kind + same stop count tween stop by stop (position + RGBA), different counts resample at the union of stops, solid vs gradient acts as a uniform gradient, linear vs radial cross-dissolves; harness extracts GRADIENT_* paints and writes the tweened stops back into the synthetic frame (rendered orb centre 0.5 grey)

(4) text by content: components::match_layers_with + SmartMatchOptions{text_content_min_similarity}: still-unmatched text layers under the same ancestor path pair greedily by Levenshtein similarity (1 - d / longer length, first 512 scalars), then nearest x/y, then order; bounded (4096 scored pairs, overflow counted in SmartMatch.text_pairs_not_scored), observable (SmartMatch.text_similarity_pairs), out-of-range threshold refused. Studio reading. OFF by default (STU-PRO-117 and Figma pair explicitly named layers by name only); harness PrototypePlay::set_smart_match_options turns it on. On the fixture it pairs 'Click: smart animate'/'Click: back to start' (0.45) and 'Details'/'Animated' (0.125)

notes.spec_basis: STU-PRO-116 transition is one of three record shapes; STU-PRO-118 'Directional transition record. {type, direction, match_layers, easing, duration} where type in {MOVE_IN, MOVE_OUT, PUSH, SLIDE_IN, SLIDE_OUT} and direction in {LEFT, RIGHT, TOP, BOTTOM}. match_layers (boolean, default false) applies the smart-animate pairing of [STU-PRO-117] on top of the directional move'; STU-PRO-119 easing {type, easing_function_cubic_bezier?, easing_function_spring?}; STU-PRO-121 'A spring easing MAY declare duration as derived ... the settling time computed from the spring parameters'; STU-PRO-117 'matching is by (layer name, position in the child hierarchy) ... tweens position, size, rotation, opacity and fill'; STU-PRO-172 slide-transition style tokens SLIDE_FROM_LEFT ... MOVE_OUT_TO_BOTTOM (same token family as the .fig enum)
notes.pushback: item (4) as asked ('instead of dissolve') conflicts with STU-PRO-117 (pairing by layer name + hierarchy position) and Figma's documented rule for explicitly named text; built as the typed, bounded Studio rule but opt-in (default off). Making it the default needs a spec decision
notes.figma_reading: Figma plugin API Transition page (developers.figma.com, read 2026-10-15): Easing types incl. GENTLE/QUICK/BOUNCY/SLOW/CUSTOM_SPRING; easingFunctionSpring {mass, stiffness, damping, initialVelocity}; DirectionalTransition MOVE_IN/MOVE_OUT/PUSH/SLIDE_IN/SLIDE_OUT, direction LEFT/RIGHT/TOP/BOTTOM, matchLayers. Figma blog 'How Figma put the bounce in spring animations': WebKit SpringSolver over mass/stiffness/damping; no preset numbers published (help article 360051748654 describes presets qualitatively). The .fig easingFunction order and direction semantics are UNVERIFIED
